purpose: Turn the completed Construction Tools Atlas corpus into a revenue-oriented execution queue without inventing search volume or earnings estimates.

groups.affiliate_in_progress: Active Amazon mapping exists and image review is already between candidate and verified. Finish this lifecycle work before starting unrelated acquisition.
groups.seo_commerce_ready_with_image: Fallback-independent bilingual core content, an active maintained Amazon mapping, and a promoted formal image are all present. These are immediate static SEO/commercial publication candidates.
groups.seo_commerce_ready_image_not_required: Fallback-independent bilingual core content and an active maintained Amazon mapping are present, while image applicability is explicitly not_required. These are also immediate static SEO/commercial publication candidates and must not be blocked on imagery.
groups.affiliate_image_backlog: Active maintained Amazon mapping exists but the required formal image is still awaiting source. These are the first acquisition pool after in-progress work.
groups.organic_image_ready: Promoted formal image exists but no active Amazon mapping exists. Useful for organic/reference expansion after commerce-ready publication.
groups.non_affiliate_image_backlog: A formal image is required but there is no active Amazon mapping. Lower revenue priority unless measured search demand later elevates it.
groups.not_required_non_affiliate: Image applicability review concluded that a representative image is not required and no active Amazon mapping exists.

execution_order: publish the combined seo_commerce_ready_with_image + seo_commerce_ready_image_not_required static detail cohort
build maintained comparison pages from genuinely confused/related pairs in the published cohort
acquire and promote images from affiliate_image_backlog in bounded waves
measure organic impressions, detail engagement and affiliate_outbound events
reorder later work using measured Search Console and click-through data when available
expand organic_image_ready and non_affiliate_image_backlog only where measured demand or reference value justifies it
